name: DropFinder
author: programus <programus@gmail.com>
description: A TotalFinder-style Visor for vanilla Finder: one hotkey drops two Finder windows in from the bottom of the screen, side by side, for drag-and-drop between them. Tabs, paths and the active tab survive hiding, Hammerspoon reloads and Finder restarts. Every other Finder window is left strictly alone.
